sources.title: Zambia Ministry of Home Affairs: passports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, Zambia
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry service page identifies the Zambian 32-page ordinary passport, distinguishes diplomatic documents, and says national passports are issued to bona fide Zambian nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passports are National Travel Documents ... issued in: 32-page ordinary passport ... Diplomatic ... applicant must be bona fide Zambian national.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's current official tourism portal requires a tourist visa for non-residents, identifies Chinese citizens as the visa-exempt exception, and offers electronic tourist-visa processing online from anywhere outside the United States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory ... if you do not have Cuban residency; it is requested through the Internet from anywhere except the United States.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as the only visa-application website approved by Côte d'Ivoire and says that, after approved pre-enrolment, the visa is printed and issued at the airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le demandeur embarque avec le document « Pré-enrôlement approuvé » ... le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement.

sources.title: Gabon DGDI e-Visa: electronic authorization and arrival sticker
sources.publisher: Direction Générale de la Documentation et de l'Immigration, Gabon
sources.officialityEvidence: The DGDI-branded official immigration portal requires a Travel Authorization Receipt before travel and says payment is made on arrival when the e-visa sticker is delivered.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicants should not travel ... without having received the Travel Authorization Receipt. Payments are made on arrival at delivery of the e-visa sticker.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: tourism e-Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Nigeria Immigration Service agreement calls the tourism route an e-Visa, makes citizens of all countries eligible, and says a visa certificate is received by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: entry regime for Zambian travel passports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's current country-and-travel-document table records Zambia: visa, while its linked visa guidance says foreign travellers who require an entry visa apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Zambia | visa. Every foreigner ... required to have an entry Ukrainian visa may apply ... to the relevant Ukraine's Embassy or Consulate.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Zambian visitor and provides an electronic tourist-visa route online from anywhere outside the United States.
conditions: Use a valid Zambian ordinary passport. Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel and complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros declaration.
The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, extendable for a further 90 days. Work, residence, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Apply with a valid Zambian ordinary passport before departure.
Complete D'Viajeros and travel with the resulting visa code and required travel documents.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, valid ordinary passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passports: Gabon electronic preapproval and arrival visa
policies.summary: Gabon's DGDI requires electronic travel authorization before travel but delivers and takes payment for the visa sticker on arrival.
conditions: Obtain the DGDI Travel Authorization Receipt before departure; the destination portal warns against travelling before receiving it.
The e-visa sticker is delivered and paid for on arrival at Libreville Leon Mba International Airport. This is not a generally border-available visa without prior authorization.

application.label: Gabon DGDI electronic travel authorization
steps: Apply online and wait for the Travel Authorization Receipt before travelling.
Enter by air through Libreville airport and receive/pay for the visa sticker on arrival.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passports: Nigeria electronic tourism visa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service makes its tourism e-Visa available to citizens of all countries and issues the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use the Nigeria Immigration Service tourism e-Visa route with a valid ordinary Zambian passport, return ticket, accommodation evidence and any other current portal requirements.
Apply, upload documents, pay online and obtain the visa certificate by email before travel. Work, residence, other visa classes and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passports: Ukraine advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's current travel-passport table requires a visa for Zambian citizens, and its visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates before travel.
conditions: Apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate before travel; this is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
Ukraine's war-related border, air-access, occupied-territory permit, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate from this visa classification.
